items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I never knew Tony Jackson, but I knew Tony's sister I met here, Mrs. Sutter.

ctx.x: Well, don't blame him, because people could steal it. I know Tony... I never knew Tony Jackson, but I knew Tony's sister I met here, Mrs. Sutter. And she said too that people would steal that music from Tony sometimes if he didn't care whether he had it published or not.
Irvin Barleen did a couple of pieces. Somebody took some of Tony's, I guess.
